title: DashCLIP: Leveraging multimodal models for generating semantic embeddings
summary: Fills the product-semantics gap in handcrafted ad features with DashCLIP, a catalog-tuned BLIP plus query encoder.

title: Inside DoorDash’s Service Mesh Journey: Part 1 — Migration at Scale
summary: Stops retry-storm cascades with load-shedding Envoy sidecars, then fixes the hidden behaviors injection exposed.

title: Using LLM to transcribe restaurant menu photos
summary: Catches LLM errors on messy menu photos with a guardrail model that predicts accuracy, sending failures to humans.

title: Introducing DoorDash’s in-house search engine
summary: Replaces Elasticsearch, bottlenecked by document replication, with a Lucene engine that ships segments via S3.

title: How DoorDash designed a successful write-heavy scalable and reliable inventory platform
summary: Fixes heavy CockroachDB load from per-item writes by batching each layer and merging JDBI batches into one UPSERT.

title: Using CockroachDB to Reduce Feature Store Costs by 75%
summary: Offloads features from costly, slow-to-resize Redis to CockroachDB, packed as JSON rows that touch fewer ranges.

title: Building scalable real time event processing with Kafka and Flink
summary: Fixes high latency and cost from bespoke multi-hop pipelines with Iguazu, a shared Kafka and Flink event platform.

title: How We Applied Client-Side Caching to Improve Feature Store Performance by 70%
summary: Shifts repeated feature reads off costly Redis to a pod-local Caffeine cache, its hit rate forecast by traffic replay.

title: Building Faster Indexing with Apache Kafka and Elasticsearch
summary: Swaps a slow, unreliable indexer for incremental Kafka and Flink indexing that re-reads changed IDs over REST.
